note: This receipt extends the native envelope test and documentation. The envelope merge and Minidump handling are unchanged.
covered: the envelope accepts exactly one native event item and at most one event.minidump attachment
duplicate event items, a missing event, a non-native event, duplicate typed Minidumps and malformed dump bytes reject before committing any event or child
the SDK event identity, timestamp, level, message, tags, contexts and extra fields are preserved
the first exception retains type, value, mechanism and data while its stacktrace is replaced with the symbolicated Minidump result
a native event without an exception receives the generated native exception and stack
generated module images merge into debug_meta.images with Minidump metadata preferred, deduplicated by (debug_id,image_addr); client-only images remain
the typed Minidump is not persisted in the attachment store, while an unmarked .dmp attachment retains its existing bytes
an envelope body above MAX_BODY_BYTES returns 413 and commits no event
limits: The app-level test uses synthetic Minidumps and disposable PostgreSQL, not the final image or a real SDK crash.
No public CI or external publication was exercised in this increment.
The product is not declared an acceptance candidate or closed.
